title: 掩埋氣體抽取與利用
summary: 本課以「建立掩埋甲烷生成、收集、氧化與利用的分流收支」為主軸，依序處理有機物庫存與可分解部分、收集與表面逸散、集氣風機能量、甲烷能量利用、井網監測與資料缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Balance generated landfill methane among collection, oxidation and utilization, progressing through Organic inventory and degradable fraction, Collection and surface escape, Gas-collection blower energy, Methane energy utilization, Well-network monitoring gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.instruction: 管網阻力、冷凝液與井數影響風機需求，增加功率不保證增加有效甲烷回收。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。
